claude.performance_metric: all businesses divested; revenue collapsed to ~US$27M (2011); workforce fell to ~190; going-concern doubt, wind-down/liquidation
claude.rationale: The slice documents that operating processes did not transfer intact with the sold products: a Nortel Business Services group provided transitional services (finance, supply chain, IT, R&D, HR, real estate) to purchasers for up to 24 months per closing, and R&D investment ceased entirely — evidence of a realized operations-vs-organization fracture as the operating organization wound down against the divested operations (p5=1). This slice codes the seller's realized wind-down (revenue to US$27M, workforce to ~190, going-concern doubt) rather than the combined acquirer entities, so whether acquired products could be aligned with buyer operating processes over time is not observable here (p4=uncertain). The controlling-intent archetype and cross-model value-capture reconciliation at any acquirer are likewise not documented in this seller-side wind-down record (t1, t2=uncertain).

gemini.performance_metric: Revenues collapsed to US$27 million in 2011
gemini.rationale: The slice documents the complete liquidation and wind-down of Nortel, with all operating businesses and patents sold to various buyers. There is no evidence of post-deal integration friction such as product/process incoherence (p4) or process/organization fracture (p5), as the entity merely provided temporary transition services before ceasing operations.

grok.performance_metric: all businesses/patents divested; revenue to US$27M; workforce ~190
grok.rationale: The slice documents a complete wind-down after asset sales, with Nortel stating it had completed divestitures of all businesses and patents, no longer invested in R&D, and focused solely on remaining-asset sales and creditor proceedings (FY2011 10-K). Although operating processes did not transfer intact and transitional services were provided, the registrant reported those TSA obligations were substantially completed by end-2011, with no documented product/process incoherence or process/organization fracture realized over the outcome window. Absence of any realized disruption evidence on p4 or p5 yields 0.
